title: File:Berlin, Mitte, Mohrenstrasse 37, Bundesministerium der Justiz.jpg
desc: The German Federal Ministry of Justice at Mohrenstraße No. 37 in Berlin-Mitte. The building was constructed from 1912 to 1913 as commercial building "Prausenhof" to a design by Ludwig Otte. In front of the building is the southernpart of the Mohren Colonnades, built in 1787 by Carl Gotthard Langhans
